builds.name: Chronobreak explosion ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Chronobreak explosion within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Chronobreak explosion within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R3 explosion is500+1.75AP; its unusually high AP ratio rewards Deathcap/high AP and MR modifiers. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

kitEvidence.formula: Ekko turns back time, entering Stasis while teleporting to where he was 4 seconds ago and dealing [200 / 350 / 500 + (1.75) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies. In addition, Ekko restores [100 / 150 / 200 + (0.6) × AP] Health, increased by [3]% for each 1% Health he lost in last 4 seconds.

builds.name: Phase Dive: AP delivery strike
builds.summary: Explore a high Phase Dive magic bonus result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high Phase Dive magic bonus result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E adds 150 + 0.4 AP magic damage to its empowered attack. Deathcap, earned Seraph AP and MR penetration target the bonus. Lich Bane is a strong alternate complete-attack hypothesis but its Spellblade is not E itself. Do not attach the three-hit passive unless the mark state is explicitly prepared and separately scored.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum selected rank unless overridden, game minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 max HP, 100 armor, 50 MR; no allied buffs, dragons or elixirs. Owner full HP. No unearned permanent stacks. Read actual AD/AP/HP and resists before the hit. Item/rune proc damage is separate; no scoring after target death. One E empowered attack, zero passive marks, legally transformed Seraph. No Q or R, and no extra delivery auto counted. Target starts at 30% HP; prior champion combat 0s. Gathering Storm fixed at minute 30; Absolute Focus only above 70% owner HP.
